title: Rays beat Guardians in Game 6 and will play the Brewers in the World Series
dek: One of two teams that have never won a title will win this one. It is the first such final since 1980.
what: The Tampa Bay Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians 7-3 on Monday 19 October and won the American League Championship Series 4 games to 2, according to reports from NPR, ESPN and others. Freddy Peralta pitched 5 and a third innings, and Junior Caminero and Yandy Diaz each hit a two-run home run, according to Yahoo Sports.

They will face the Milwaukee Brewers. Neither team has won a World Series, so a first-time champion is guaranteed. NPR and CBS Sports report it is the first final between two such teams since 1980. Game 1 is on Friday 23 October in Milwaukee.
An account on X posted earlier on Monday that the Rays were one win from their third American League pennant. After the game it posted that the matchup was set.
why: Fans of two small-market teams have waited a long time, and a title is certain for one of them. Former Rays players, shown at the game in one post, were part of the talk.
next: Game 1 is on Friday 23 October in Milwaukee.
